title: Mock texts 'Market Morning' and 'A Morning at the Market'
subject: English Language
unit: Summer 2: Timed Sections A and C; mock
source: Seeded from english-language/y10 lessons 66, 70 (Mock texts 'Market Morning' and 'A Morning at the Market' (pupil PDF))
intro: Mock paper. Answer every question in the spaces provided. Show your working: marks are given for method. The marks for each question are shown in brackets.

questions.q: Which best transforms an idea from Text One?
options: Mr Osei saved tomatoes for a widow.
Our market is a village that meets every morning, where neighbours look out for each other.
questions.a: C) Our market is a village that meets every morning, where neighbours look out for each other.. It turns the idea into a point for the article's purpose; the others copy details.

questions.q: Which opening suits a youth council speech?
options: Who here has ever been helped by a stranger?
Once upon a time, there was a market.
questions.a: A) Who here has ever been helped by a stranger?. A direct question suits a speech to young people; the others are a letter and a story.

questions.q: write your article in the portal response box. Starter: a headline, then your opening
questions.a: Marked with the Q8 criteria: ideas from both texts transformed (AO1); article form and register for newspaper readers (AO4); accurate, varied writing (AO5)
questions.model: No model during the mock; shared in feedback: 'Why Our Market Matters. At five in the morning, while most of the town sleeps, a village wakes up...'

questions.q: check you covered all three bullets
Plan (5 minutes): six ideas, three from each text, in your own words, under the three bullets
questions.model: Teacher reminder only: kindness (Osei, the flower-girl), community ('a village'), fairness to the poor (bruised fruit), daily routine.

questions.q: complete the planning grid and write the opening paragraph of the speech
questions.a: A completed grid and an opening
questions.model: Grid: three bullets x two texts + my idea | Opening: hook, two transformed ideas, purpose

questions.q: write one more paragraph covering the second bullet
write your Year 11 Language goal and how you will reach it
Select one idea from each text for the first bullet, in your own words
questions.model: I do: Osei's tomatoes become 'quietly looking after those who need it'.
